title: BEAM-ML - Blood & Exam Assessment Model using Machine Learning
summary: A machine learning project predicting cognitive decline from blood biomarker and cognitive assessment data, trained on a synthetic dataset generated to protect the privacy of the original ADRC clinical dataset. It calls SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a Metadata schema and evaluate_quality to generate and validate the synthetic tabular data used for model training.
evidence: scripts/CTGAN/train_ctgan.py:3-9 imports CTGANSynthesizer, Metadata, evaluate_quality from sdv and trains synthesizer with them
needs: scripts/CTGAN directory name suggests vendoring but code only imports the sdv package, not a vendored copy
